title: Mortgage Broker Pipeline
description: Borrowers, loan files by stage, conditions and referral partners. Tracking only.

spec.useCase: Concetta Ruiz processes loan files for a small mortgage brokerage and uses this to see which files close this month, which conditions are still open, which locks end soon and which referral partners to call. Tracking only; it holds no rates or financial advice.

text.text: Your pipeline in one place. Follow each Loan from pre-approval to funding, clear Conditions before they hold up closing, and keep Borrowers and Referral partners in view. Tracking only; this holds no rates, quotes or financial advice.
Every file moves through the same stages. Keep the stage honest.
Application: disclosures delivered within the required window.
Clear to close: closing date confirmed.
Funded: file closed out, partner thanked.
Open Conditions, Today and This week views.
Contact each borrower about anything Open and mark it Requested.
Mark Received when it arrives and Cleared when underwriting agrees.
Tell borrowers exactly what to send and in what format.
Escalate anything Overdue to the loan officer the same day.
The closing disclosure must reach the borrower in time. Count back from the closing date.
Rate lock covers the closing date
Closing date confirmed with the title company
Mark the loan Funded and the borrower Closed
Send a thank-you to the referral partner
Update the partner with the milestone reached.
Thank them when the file funds.
Open Referral partners, Next 30 days view.
Reach out to each partner and update Last contact.
Offer a short market-update lunch to your top three.
